body.statement:
For every feasible \((H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)\), the certified partial procedure \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}\) in \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\) terminates after at most
\[
 B_\star(n,L,\gamma)=6+2^{n-2}+3^{n\{\gamma+(n-1)L+1\}}
\]
transitions and emits exactly one of \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\), \(\operatorname{FAIL}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{lag}}(\mathcal A))\), or \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\).  Every success has \(F\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) and \(F(P_M)=\theta_M(y;x)\) for all \(M\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\).  Every failure encodes two final models \(M_0,M_1\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\) on the fixed alphabets such that \(P_{M_0}=P_{M_1}\) on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\) and \(\theta_{M_0}(y;x)\ne\theta_{M_1}(y;x)\).  Consequently success implies \(\operatorname{UID}=1\), failure implies \(\operatorname{UID}=0\), and no converse is claimed.  In its defined order, the procedure returns the displayed success on \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}\), the displayed failure on the binary lag-switch query in \(\mathrm{def:lag\text{-}switch\text{-}regression}\), returns \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F_{\mathrm{ADGGM}})\) when neither special branch matches and \(\mathsf{Adj}_{\mathrm{ADGGM}}(H,X,Y,\gamma)\) holds, next returns \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F_{\mathrm{A25},\mathbb W})\) for the first enumerated nonempty \(\mathbb W\subseteq V\setminus\{X,Y\}\) satisfying \(\mathsf{FD}_{\mathrm{A25}}(H,\mathbb W,X,Y,\gamma,L)\), then uses one saturated ordinary-ID call when the directed part of \(H\) is acyclic and loop-free, and returns \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\) in every residual case.
body.justification: The narrowed theorem proves termination and soundness for a three-way partial procedure.
body.gap: Neither success nor failure is complete for all feasible inputs.
body.consumer: EasyRCA uses success, displays certified failure, and separately reports unknown.
body.proof_tex:
Set
\[
 N_\star=n\{\gamma+(n-1)L+1\}.
\]
Feasibility gives distinct \(X,Y\in V\), hence \(n\geq2\), and gives \(0\leq\gamma\leq L\).  The first two rules in \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\) compare the input with fixed finite templates.  The adjustment rule and each front-door candidate test use ancestry, descendant, simple-path, blocking, and directed-cycle searches in the finite graph \(H\).  The front-door search is entered only for \(\gamma\in\{0,L\}\) and examines the \(2^{n-2}-1<2^{n-2}\) nonempty subsets of \(V\setminus\{X,Y\}\) in a fixed order.  The temporal sets produced by either imported branch are finite, and their product alphabets are finite by \(\mathrm{ass:finite\text{-}alphabet}\).

If the saturated-ID rule is reached, \(\mathrm{prop:acyclic\text{-}summary\text{-}reduction}\) gives
\[
 |A^\star|\leq N_\star.
\]
By \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\), an ID memo state assigns each vertex of \(A^\star\) one of the three labels absent, random, or fixed, and no state is revisited.  Thus at most
\[
 3^{|A^\star|}\leq3^{N_\star}
\]
ID memo transitions occur.  Counting one initialization and the five ordered top-level rule evaluations contributes at most six further transitions.  Therefore the total is at most
\[
 6+(2^{n-2}-1)+3^{N_\star}
 \leq6+2^{n-2}+3^{N_\star}
 =B_\star(n,L,\gamma).
\]
Every rule is deterministic, a matching return exits immediately, and the last rule returns \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\) in every residual case.  Exactly one of the three advertised tags is therefore emitted.

We verify success soundness branch by branch.  If the first rule matches, the input is exactly \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}\).  By \(\mathrm{prop:outside\text{-}witness\text{-}identification}\),
\[
 F_{\mathrm{out}}(P_M)=\theta_M(1;0)
 \qquad\text{for every }M\in\mathfrak M(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}}).
\]
The same proposition displays \(F_{\mathrm{out}}\) as a finite sum of observed conditional probabilities.  Replacing each conditional by its joint-cylinder numerator divided by its conditioning-cylinder denominator is legitimate under \(\mathrm{ass:cylinder\text{-}positivity}\), so \(\mathrm{def:cylinder\text{-}language}\) gives \(F_{\mathrm{out}}\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}})\).

If the adjustment rule returns, \(\mathrm{prop:scg\text{-}adjustment\text{-}transfer}\) gives
\[
 F_{\mathrm{ADGGM}}\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A),
 \qquad
 F_{\mathrm{ADGGM}}(P_M;y,x)=\theta_M(y;x)
 \quad\text{for every }M\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A).
\]
If the front-door rule returns on its first passing set \(\mathbb W\), its tested premise is precisely \(\mathsf{FD}_{\mathrm{A25}}(H,\mathbb W,X,Y,\gamma,L)\).  Therefore \(\mathrm{prop:assaad\text{-}frontdoor\text{-}transfer}\) gives
\[
 F_{\mathrm{A25},\mathbb W}\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A),
 \qquad
 F_{\mathrm{A25},\mathbb W}(P_M;y,x)=\theta_M(y;x)
 \quad\text{for every }M\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A).
\]
Finally, if the saturated ordinary-ID rule returns \(F\), its precondition says that \(H^{\to}\) is acyclic and loop-free.  Hence \(\mathrm{prop:acyclic\text{-}summary\text{-}reduction}\) gives
\[
 F\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A),
 \qquad
 F(P_M)=\theta_M(y;x)
 \quad\text{for every }M\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A).
\]
These are all success-producing rules, proving the asserted semantics of every success.

There is one failure-producing rule.  When the binary lag-switch template with \(x=0\) and \(y=1\) matches, \(\mathrm{def:lag\text{-}switch\text{-}regression}\) supplies the rational structural tables, and \(\mathrm{prop:lag\text{-}switch\text{-}collision}\) proves that the encoded final models satisfy
\[
 M_0,M_1\in\mathfrak M(H,1,\mathcal A),\qquad
 P_{M_0}=P_{M_1}\text{ on }\Omega_{\mathcal A},
\]
while
\[
 \theta_{M_0}(1;0)=\frac{13}{50}\ne\frac12=\theta_{M_1}(1;0).
\]
Thus every failure has exactly the claimed fixed-alphabet certificate semantics.

For the semantic tag implications, suppose first that \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\) is returned and take arbitrary \(M_0,M_1\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\) with \(P_{M_0}=P_{M_1}\) on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\).  The two measures agree on every cylinder entering the finite expression \(F\); positivity makes all its denominators defined.  Consequently
\[
 \theta_{M_0}(y;x)=F(P_{M_0})=F(P_{M_1})=\theta_{M_1}(y;x).
\]
The quantified definition \(\mathrm{def:uniform\text{-}identification}\) yields \(\operatorname{UID}=1\).  On a failure, the displayed certified pair instead witnesses that the implication in that definition is false, so \(\operatorname{UID}=0\).  No assertion is derived from \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\), and therefore no converse has been proved or claimed.  The final branch-order description follows directly from the ordered rules in \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\).
